Squads:

Team News: A quick turnaround usually means very little tinkering with the playing XI, but India have a decision to make. Ishan Kishan has been ruled out with a groin strain, opening up a spot in the playing XI. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is the reserve batter in this squad and he could well be a like-for-like replacement. But his inclusion will mean pushing Sanju Samson down to number 3 and disturbing a well-set combination. In Shivam Dube, India have another finisher in their midst and also someone who can bowl a couple of overs. Michael Bracewell and Mitchell Santner were impressive in the first match and helped pull things back in the middle-overs with wickets. Can India go the same way and sacrifice batting depth to play an extra spinner in the form of Varun Chakaravarthy? Toss and team sheets coming up shortly.
Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is shadow-practicing on the centre wicket and he gets a pat on his back by Sitanshu Kotak, India's batting coach. That tells us that he's playing, but where will he slot in?

Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, out Caught by Glenn Phillips!!
